papers.title_en: Agentic AI-Assisted Modeling for Production Scheduling: Assessment in Constraint Programming
papers.authors: Ángel Sánchez-Fernández, Javier Pernas-Álvarez, Diego Crespo-Pereira
papers.evidence: 通用LLM智能体从自然语言描述构建约束规划模型
papers.tldr: 生产调度优化建模依赖专家且成本高，现有LLM自动建模多聚焦MILP并依赖专门训练，智能体决策支持又常假设模型已存在。本文用通用LLM智能体，结合单/多智能体与MCP求解器文档检索，从自然语言构建并实现约束规划模型。在六类工业调度问题上，多智能体将生成脚本可直接运行率从14.8%提至59.3%，较简单四题达80.6%。表明公式化建模已较可行，实现仍是主要瓶颈，紧耦合仓储调度尚待突破。
papers.abstract_en: Developing optimization models for production scheduling requires substantial expert effort. Research on large language models (LLMs) has followed two directions: specialized approaches for automated modeling, mostly for mixed-integer linear programming, which often rely on dedicated training or problem-specific architectures that limit industrial deployment; and agentic artificial intelligence for operational decision support, which generally assumes that the optimization model already exists. This study bridges both directions by assessing whether general-purpose LLMs, orchestrated as agents without task-specific training, can formulate and implement constraint programming models from natural-language problem descriptions. Singleagent and multi-agent architectures are integrated with a Model Context Protocol server that provides context-aware retrieval of solver documentation to mitigate hallucinations during implementation. Both are compared with a direct LLM baseline on six industry-oriented problems covering flow-shop, job-shop, flexible job-shop and resource-constrained warehouse scheduling, using three LLMs and assessing modeling accuracy, execution success, latency and token consumption. Formulation proves largely within reach of current LLMs, whereas implementation is the main barrier. The multi-agent workflow raises the share of scripts that run correctly as generated from 14.8% with a direct LLM call to 59.3%, reaching 80.6% on the four less complex problems, while tightly coupled intralogistics models remain an open challenge.

papers.title_en: Harnessing Language Models as Optimization Modeling Agents
papers.authors: Yunxiang Luo, Xin Xu, Tianhao Chen, Zhixi Xiong, Peiqi Jiang, Fan Zhang, Wei Shao, Xuejian Gao, Yuwei Fan, Can Yang
papers.evidence: 将大模型作为优化建模智能体生成求解器程序
papers.tldr: 大语言模型可将自然语言优化问题转为求解器程序，但可靠生成正确建模与实现仍困难。本文提出OPTICYCLE与OPTISTATE两个轻量推理harness，仅用单一模型角色、无需额外训练。在9个基准2634题、11个Qwen变体（0.6B-27B）上，执行引导修订一致提升宏准确率，最高达49.46个百分点。两harness在同模型比较中优于六种智能体工作流，并在可比规模下胜过四种后训练优化模型，显示轻量推理封装可成为有效替代。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can translate natural-language optimization problems into solver programs, but reliably producing correct formulations and implementations remains challenging. Existing approaches improve optimization modeling through agentic workflows or task-specific post-training. This raises a practical question: can a lightweight harness using a single model role achieve competitive performance without additional training? We introduce OPTICYCLE and OPTISTATE, two lightweight inference harnesses for optimization modeling, and evaluate them on nine benchmarks comprising 2,634 problems using 11 Qwen variants spanning 0.6B-27B parameters. Our results show that execution-guided revision consistently improves macro accuracy over direct generation for all evaluated models, with gains of up to 49.46 percentage points. Despite their simplicity, both harnesses outperform six adapted agentic workflows in same-model comparisons and four evaluated post-trained optimization models at comparable model sizes, without additional training. Explicit formulation state provides further but model-dependent improvements, suggesting that additional structure is not universally beneficial.

papers.title_en: Ambiguity-Aware Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Operations Research under Logical Inconsistency
papers.authors: Chengxi She, Xingyu Lu, Yue Zhao, Qitao Shi, Caihua Chen
papers.evidence: 多智能体框架自动完成运筹学问题的建模与求解
papers.tldr: 真实运筹问题常因描述含糊和逻辑不一致而难以直接建模。AMAO先由逻辑对齐智能体与运筹专家结构生成变量、参数、目标和约束的对齐候选，再用来源充分性验证器判断是否需交互补全。32B模型实现86.8%错误恢复成功率与60.4%求解准确率，分别为基线的1.98和1.86倍；交互修复在需澄清案例达90.71%完整描述准确率。该框架为自动运筹建模提供了歧义感知基准与可验证修复流程。
papers.abstract_en: Operations research (OR) problems are often described by stakeholders with incomplete knowledge and vague expressions in real-world settings. Such ambiguous descriptions can not be used to formulation directly. Thus, automating OR problems solving requires processing this logical inconsistency in advance. To address this challenge, we propose an \textbf{A}mbiguity-Aware \textbf{M}ulti-Agent Framework for \textbf{A}utomated \textbf{O}R Problem Solving, \textbf{AMAO}, which first addresses logical inconsistency through two-stage alignment before downstream formulation and coding. Specifically, a logical alignment agent with OR-guided experts structure first produces an aligned candidate using supervised routing over variables, parameters, objectives, and constraints. Then, a source-sufficiency verifier determines whether the original description supports the required repairs. When evidence is insufficient, an interactive repair agent requests additional information and revises the description before modeling and coding. In addition, an ambiguity-aware benchmark and its matched dialogue extension are proposed to support evaluation of both stages. The 32B model achieved 86.8\% error-recovery success and 60.4\% solution accuracy, reaching 1.98 and 1.86 times the respective base-model scores. The 8B model achieved 47.9\% solution accuracy, exceeding the best evaluated variant such as DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Claude-sonnet-4.5. Interactive repair further achieved 90.71\% complete-description accuracy when cases requiring clarification. These results support combining context-based repair with evidence assessment and targeted user clarification for automated OR modeling.

papers.title_en: Fix What's Wrong, Keep What's Right: Hallucination Repair for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling
papers.authors: Jiageng Wu, Chao Shen, Zihan Guo, Junyan Shao, Zongyan Zhang, Jie Song, Zhong Li, Mingyang Sun
papers.evidence: 大语言模型优化建模与幻觉修复
papers.tldr: LLM 自动构建优化模型时，生成的模型与代码常与原问题不一致，这类问题被称为优化建模幻觉。OPT-Kraken 是首个免训练的事后修复框架：它抽取问题需求与实例数据，从问题-模型保真、模型-代码一致、数据接地三方面定位错误，并按影响范围选择修复粒度；局部修复时把类别规则与实例证据编译为契约，限定可编辑内容与预期效果。在多个基准与基座模型上，它能有效修复幻觉并保留原本正确的产物。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored to automate operations research modeling, reduce modeling time and lower the expertise barrier to optimization based decision support. However, this process often introduces inconsistencies between generated artifacts and the original problem, which we refer to as optimization modeling hallucinations. Despite progress in general-purpose hallucination mitigation, optimization modeling poses a distinct repair challenge: restoring fidelity to the original problem through coordinated model-code updates. We introduce OPT-Kraken, a training-free hallucination repair framework. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first post-hoc framework for repairing hallucinations in LLM-based optimization modeling artifacts. It extracts problem requirements and instance data, localizes errors by checking problem-model fidelity, model-code consistency, and data grounding, and selects repair granularity by the affected scope. For local repair, category rules and instance evidence are compiled into contracts specifying permitted edits, expected effects, and protected content. Experiments on established optimization modeling benchmarks show positive gains across automatic modeling frameworks and fine-tuned models. On zero-shot artifacts from multiple base models, OPT-Kraken effectively repairs optimization modeling hallucinations while preserving initially correct artifacts. These results demonstrate effective and controlled repair for LLM-based optimization modeling artifacts.

papers.title_en: Think in Strategies, Act with Tools: Traceable Agentic Optimization for Combinatorial Problems
papers.authors: Zhongnian Li, Shi Xu, Peng Ying, Weikang Gong, Zhixiao Wang, Xinzheng Xu
papers.evidence: 面向组合优化求解的工具增强大模型智能体
papers.tldr: OPRO等提示优化方法虽能借助LLM生成候选解，但优化过程难以追踪，历史迭代信息无法被充分积累，限制了解的质量。为此，论文提出工具增强策略智能体TASA，将优化过程分解为可追踪的策略选择，并依据优化轨迹逐步规划策略。TASA还用LLM构建问题专用工具，引入策略引导的自适应工具规划器，利用轨迹信息高效更新候选解。在共享候选评估预算下，实验验证了其解质量与策略引导搜索的可追踪性，并在持续探索下建立局部收敛。
papers.abstract_en: Optimization by PROmpting (OPRO) directly leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate candidate solutions through natural-language prompting. However, OPRO's optimization process is difficult to track, which prevents LLMs from capturing useful information accumulated over previous iterations, thereby limiting solution quality. To address this limitation, we propose a Tool-Augmented Strategic Agent (TASA) which summarizes and exploits trajectory to improve solution quality. Specifically, TASA plans the strategy for each step based on the optimization trajectory, which decomposes the optimization process into traceable strategy selections. Moreover, we leverage LLM to construct problem-specific tools and introduce a strategy-guided adaptive tool planner, which efficiently utilizes the information of trajectory to update solutions. We establish local convergence under persistent exploration and evaluate the complete framework under a shared candidate-evaluation budget. The results support its solution quality and the traceability of strategy-guided search.

papers.title_en: Harnessing LLMs with Direction-Scope Control for Combinatorial Solver Refinement
papers.authors: Yili Cao, Anqi Li, Haoran Li, Yongtang Shi, Zicheng Zhang
papers.evidence: LLM智能体以方向范围控制改进组合优化求解器
papers.tldr: LLM自动启发式设计迭代修订组合优化求解器时，常破坏已验证可行性，出现可行性振荡且反馈冗余成本高。DiSH联合控制修订方向与范围，选取代表性失败证据引导更新，并随可行行为积累逐步收窄修订范围。在9个CO基准上，DiSH提升QYI分数并降低可行性振荡，反馈token消耗较全反馈方法约减半。为harness控制下的组合优化求解器精炼提供了强基线。
papers.abstract_en: Harnesses are increasingly unlocking the potential of large language model (LLM) agents by making their actions more controllable. In automatic heuristic design (AHD) for combinatorial optimization (CO), LLMs iteratively revise solvers using execution and verification feedback. However, these revisions often break previously validated solver behavior, making refinement unstable and costly. We characterize this pattern as feasibility oscillation and document it across CO benchmarks, AHD methods, and backbone LLMs. Tracing this oscillation, our analysis reveals that feasibility degradation often follows large solver revisions, while substantial feedback redundancy makes it harder to identify which failures deserve attention. Motivated by these findings, we introduce DiSH, a harness that jointly controls revision direction and scope. It selects representative failure evidence to guide each update and progressively narrows the revision scope as feasible behavior accumulates. Across nine CO benchmarks, DiSH consistently improves QYI scores and reduces feasibility oscillation, while roughly halving feedback token consumption relative to prior methods that use full feedback. These results establish DiSH as a strong baseline for solver refinement under harness control.

papers.title_en: Directing to Diversify: Multi-Directional Search for Automatic Heuristic Design
papers.authors: Jianghan Zhu, Jianan Zhou, Fei Liu, Ni Zhang, Yaoxin Wu, Zhuoyi Lin, Zhiguang Cao
papers.evidence: 基于LLM的多方向搜索自动设计组合优化启发式
papers.tldr: 针对LLM自动启发式设计多依赖进化框架、转换方向未被显式利用的问题，提出多方向扰动-重写搜索PRS。PRS在生成层将启发式转换分解为扩展、压缩与引导三种方向，并用广度优先搜索与自适应算子控制组织候选探索。在多种组合优化任务上持续发现高质量启发式，提升搜索多样性与持续性，展现方法有效性和通用性。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong potential to automate heuristic design for NP-hard combinatorial optimization (CO) tasks without human intervention. Recent methods predominantly rely on evolutionary computation (EC) frameworks, where heuristic diversification is mainly induced through EC-like operators or downstream selection, while the direction of heuristic transformation remains largely unharnessed. In this paper, we propose a multi-directional Perturbation-Rewrite Search (PRS) framework for automatic heuristic design that factorizes heuristic transformation through directional search primitives at the generation level. Specifically, PRS operates on heuristic ideas through three complementary directions: expansion toward richer and more expressive designs, compression toward simpler and less specialized designs, and steering for fine-grained refinement, together enabling broader and more sustained exploration of diverse regions in the heuristic design space. PRS further organizes candidate exploration within a breadth-first search-based process with adaptive operator control, which ensures thorough candidate utilization and sustained exploration, and maintains strong search dynamics while preventing premature convergence. Extensive empirical results across diverse CO tasks show that PRS consistently discovers high-quality heuristics, demonstrating the effectiveness and generality of explicitly directional exploration design.

papers.title_en: HEMO: Harness Self-Evolution for Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization
papers.authors: Jianghan Zhu, Cong Zhang, Ni Zhang, Yifan Yang, Yew Soon Ong, Zhiguang Cao
papers.evidence: 大语言模型驱动组合优化自演化框架
papers.tldr: 多目标组合优化中的自动算子设计常借助大语言模型生成搜索与变异算子，但多数方法只进化算子本身，负责发现算子的流程保持固定，难以适应新的Pareto权衡与算子交互。HEMO把这一自动设计框架（harness）本身作为自进化优化对象，维护持久状态并逐模块更新检索经验、改进算子、选择父代与编排搜索步骤的逻辑。下游解质量与运行时间驱动更新，折扣UCB调度器按模块效用变化分配适应方向，持久记忆文件系统跨状态保留候选结果与诊断反馈。在八个MOCO任务和两种结构不同的进化骨干上，HEMO优于传统进化、神经网络与基于LLM的AOD基线，并能有效迁移到相关任务。
papers.abstract_en: Automatic operator design (AOD) has increasingly adopted large language models (LLMs) to generate problem-specific search and variation operators for multi-objective combinatorial optimization (MOCO). Yet most methods evolve the operators while leaving the process that discovers them fixed. This limits adaptation as new Pareto trade-offs and operator interactions change where and how the search should proceed. We introduce HEMO, which makes the AOD harness itself a self-evolving optimization target. HEMO maintains a persistent harness state and updates one module at a time, revising the logic that determines which experience to retrieve, which operators to improve, which parents to select, and how to formulate the orchestration of search steps. Downstream solution quality and runtime guide these updates, while a discounted UCB scheduler directs adaptation toward promising modules as their utility changes. A persistent memory filesystem preserves candidate outcomes and diagnostic feedback across harness states, enabling successive states to build on accumulated optimization experience. Experiments across eight MOCO tasks and two structurally distinct evolutionary backbones demonstrate strong performance against conventional evolutionary, neural, and LLM-based AOD baselines, together with effective transfer to related tasks. HEMO extends automatic operator design beyond evolving individual operators to improving the search process that discovers them.
